query: A logistics company manages multiple warehouses responsible for distributing products to various retail stores. The daily demand for each store is provided in “customer_demand.csv,” while the daily supply capacity of each warehouse is detailed in “supply_capacity.csv.” The cost of transporting each unit of product from each warehouse to each store is recorded in “transportation_costs.csv.” The objective is to determine the optimal quantity of products to be shipped from each warehouse to each store, ensuring that all store demands are met without exceeding the supply capacity of any warehouse, while minimizing the total transportation cost.
